## Description {#details}

<p>This file implements a map that provides insertion order iteration.</p>


<p>The interface is purposefully minimal. The key is assumed to be cheap to copy and 2 copies are kept, one for indexing in a DenseMap, one for iteration in a SmallVector.</p>
